title: Killer in Love
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Ryuto Suzuki, a timid college student mocked by his peers, agrees to pose as the boyfriend of Kokoa, a woman being harassed by a stalker. Protecting her draws him into a spiral of killings as her dangerous exes and stalkers close in, and the romance turns tragic.
life_message: It presents love as something a person may kill for, and traces how that devotion destroys him.

content.note: Ryuto kills several people, some in self-defense (MAL reviews); AniList Gore 80%, Body Horror; MU Murder, Mutilation.
Stalkers, dark romance and tragedy throughout (AniList Tragedy 86%, MU Dark Ambience; MAL synopsis).
Teasing over virginity, an experienced female lead; AniList Rape tag at only 20% and MU Netorare (1 vote) (to verify).
Mocking and harsh speech among college peers (to verify).
Drinking party where the leads meet (AniList, MU synopsis).
MU lists depression, suicidal character and despair; database tags only (to verify).
Killing to protect a partner and a yandere dynamic framed romantically at first (AniList Yandere 84%; MAL reviews).

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Ryuto answers threats to Kokoa personally and lethally rather than through police (MAL reviews; AniList Crime, Anti-Hero).

Order vs freedom.evidence: Characters act outside law and rules; the couple go on the run (MU On the Run).

Civic vs kin.evidence: Loyalty narrows to one partner above everyone else (AniList Yandere, Fake Relationship).

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Little deference to rank; college peers bully freely (AniList Bullying).

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: No religious frame; secular college setting (to verify).

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Survival and self-protection dominate as threats mount (MAL synopsis).

folkways.japan: The college drinking party and peer mockery over inexperience reflect Japanese university social pressure, shown here as the hook for Ryuto's isolation.

delivery.evidence: No review consulted on delivery; summaries show the message carried by plot and character choices (to verify).
delivery.note: The sources say little about delivery, so the default reading is that the message rides on the story's events.

winners_losers: No one wins: Ryuto's devotion turns him into a killer and the romance ends in tragedy; bullies and stalkers are shown as predatory.
